title: Managing Churn to Maximize Profits
eligible_reason: Machine-learning (stochastic gradient boosting with a profit-based loss) approach to targeting proactive churn-retention campaigns, evaluated on retention-campaign data with a single binary campaign indicator (w) and post-intervention churn. No staggered adoption and no DiD or event study.
design_notes: LemmensGupta2020_replication.rmd with main.r, procedure_wsgb_model.R, SGBwithuserdefinedlossfunction.R, campaign evaluation and Gini/top-decile scripts on mysynthdata.csv (y = churn, revenues, w = treatment, x1-x11). Regression inventory empty.
data_files_note: README: data under NDA; replication uses a synthetic dataset that mimics the original.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); OpenAlex abstract read from data/frame/mksc.jsonl. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
